scenario: AITA for letting people who walk with their phones 2 inches from their faces walk straight into me on the sidewalk? | To be honest, it only happened 4-5 times to this day, but when the situation is right, I just can't resist. I am shocked by the inability of some people to discipline themselves to be in the present moment and to be aware of their environment. I'm sure I'm not the only one thinking that.
